iti87:2.1: tayome bhikkhave akusalavitakkā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhikā anibbāna saṃvattanikā
iti87:2.3: kāmavitakko bhikkhave andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:2.4: byāpādavitakko bhikkhave andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:2.5: vihiṃsāvitakko bhikkhave andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:2.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo akusalā vitakkā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhikā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.
iti87:3.1: tayome bhikkhave kusalā vitakkā anandhakaraṇā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhikā avighātapakkhikā nibbānasaṃvattanikā
iti87:3.3: nekkhammavitakko bhikkhave anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:3.4: abyāpādavitakko bhikkhave anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:3.5: avihiṃsāvitakko bhikkhave anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
iti87:3.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo kusalā vitakkā anandhakaraṇā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññābuddhikā avighātapakkhikā nibbānasaṃvattanikāti.
